author: Enkim

Hi bobyv87
 , i didnt look at charts, i was answering according to IFs posts only
:) Your thoughs are thoughs of RTM member. Ordinary retailer dont have a
 clue about iQM and other stuff. They just see nice RS level, in here
represeted by that nice high, and they usually wait for break and trade
the pullback, put SL below last low and thats it .. some of them may
trade break of this RS, some bounce. IMO part of this RS trader group
will wait for price to go back to this newly created swap level and
trade there too (and they pu SL below first pullback). So why not to
take theirs stops and do small trade north before going south? Just my
opinion :) Best wishes enkim!
